description.value: Earl of Sandwich is a quick-service sandwich chain with a Langley location inside Willoughby Town Centre. The chain is known for hot, freshly baked sandwiches and has earned repeated recognition on TripAdvisor's Top 10 Best Quick Bite list. Online ordering for pick-up or delivery is available, making it a convenient fuel stop for cyclists passing through the area.

address.value: 20727 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley, V2Y1X1
